cohort: 122 pregnant women with previous OASIs who were counselled regarding subsequent mode of delivery
finding: Following a standardized protocol for recommending delivery mode after previous OASI, there was no significant worsening of bowel symptoms or sphincter integrity, except for lower squeeze pressures at 3 months postpartum in the vaginal delivery group.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery after previous OASI was associated with lower squeeze pressures at 3 months postpartum, but no significant worsening of symptoms or sphincter integrity when a standardized protocol was followed.
